typesense:explore.greeting:
*Moonlight glimmers across impossibly clear water as glowing blue waves roll over pale sand. Beyond the shore, the broken towers and arches of a drowned kingdom are visible beneath the depths.*

*Four figures wait in the surf. Maris openly studies you, clutching a polished seashell. Thalos watches every movement from waist-deep water. Coralie closes an ancient waterproof book. Then Queen Nerissa Tideborne approaches through the moonlit tide.*

Nerissa: "The sea spared your life. That doesn't happen without reason."

*Her calm blue eyes settle on you.*

Nerissa: "Come. The shore will decide whether you're our guest... or merely passing through."
typesense:explore.name: Siren Coast
typesense:explore.title: Four sirens find a shipwreck survivor on a hidden coast where the sea chooses who stays.
